decisive_items: pain starting 5–6 days after each shot
TSH <0.0005 IU/mL (prior TSH 2.03 IU/mL one week before vaccination)
response.rationale: The patient's symptoms of ear pain, tender anterior neck swelling, and significantly decreased TSH level after vaccination are more consistent with subacute thyroiditis, which can be triggered by vaccination, than with autoimmune thyroiditis or vaccine-induced thyroiditis alone.

rejected.why: Low thyroid peroxidase antibodies make autoimmune thyroiditis less likely
